description_en: Creates a code for a converged communication authentication service
description_zh: 融合认证方案用于标识App下的认证场景，一般一个认证方案对应一个App包名、包签名。调用本接口创建融合认证方案并获取方案Code
kebab_example: aliyun dypnsapi create-scheme-config --scheme-name 'APP测试方案' --platform Android --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSchemeConfig

parameters.help_en: The service name, which can be up to 10 characters in length and can contain letters
parameters.help_zh: 方案名称，由中、英文字母构成，长度限制为10个字符
parameters.name: scheme_name

parameters.help_en:
The app platform.

Valid values:

Android
iOS
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: The app name, which can be up to 20 characters in length and can contain letters
parameters.help_zh: 应用方案的App名称，由中、英文字母构成，长度限制20个字符
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The package name. This parameter is required when Platform is set to Android. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: 包名，Platform为Android时必选。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: android_package_name

parameters.help_en: The package signature. This parameter is required when Platform is set to Android. The signature must be 32 characters in length and can contain digits and letters
parameters.help_zh: 包签名，Platform为Android时必选。由数字和字母组成，长度为32个字符
parameters.name: android_package_sign

parameters.help_en: The bundle ID. This parameter is required when OsType is set to iOS. The bundle ID must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh: BundleID，osType为iOS时必选。由数字、字母、短划线（-）、下划线或点组成，长度限制为1~128个字符
parameters.name: ios_bundle_id

parameters.help_en: The reserved field. HTML5 apps are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 保留字段，暂不支持H5方案
parameters.name: h5_url

parameters.help_en: The reserved field. HTML5 apps are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 保留字段，暂不支持H5方案
parameters.name: h5_origin

状态码。

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见API返回码 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnvs/developer-reference/api-return-code?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.5c3a662fbgeAuk)

Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true

Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：请求成功。

false：请求失败
